text:
Alex: quick q — for Private deploys, should we surface an endpoint alias (split-horizon DNS) inside customer VPCs or ship a tiny resolver shim in the tenant subnets? alias avoids distro work but cert rotation + cross-account delegation feels hairy. Thoughts?
Meera: alias is nice for app teams (no extra hop) but asking customers to accept delegated zones has bitten us before. also Route53 cross-account ACLs + audit trail is annoying.
Jon: shim has clear operational control: rotate certs locally, terminate mTLS there, and keep controlplane interactions over a single private channel. downside: we own lifecycle + need bootstrap auth for the shim.
Sasha: what about combining PrivateLink + per-tenant CNAME mapping at the customer side? that gives us an alias feel without delegations. we still get control over endpoint target.
Mike: PrivateLink = more ENIs, quotas, and cost per endpoint. For hundreds of customers that's non-trivial. ENI limits per AZ could force us into per-customer region planning.
Alex: sketch two flows — pasted simple ASCII: 

``
# Alias flow
customer VPC -> Route53 private hosted zone (delegated) -> alias -> redwood-private-lb
# Shim flow
customer VPC -> resolver-shim (ASG/private subnet) -> private endpoint -> redwood-controlplane
```

Alias pros: lower tail latency, less infra to run. Alias cons: delegation, cert scope, cross-account ops.
Shim pros: single control for certs/rotation, easier rollback, can enforce observability at shim. Shim cons: +hop + ops + scaling.
Elaine: ops perspective — if we pick shim we need a clear rollout: healthcheck schema, version compatibility, and console hooks to show shim health and cert age. support tickets otherwise will be a firehose.
infra-bot: Deploy job #4612: canary shim image pushed to staging at 2026-03-20T15:12Z :rocket:
Meera: OK next step — spike to measure 99th perc added latency for shim vs alias and a rough cost model for PrivateLink per-customer. I'll own this and post results by EOD Thu.
Alex: sgtm. @Jon can you draft a short cert-rotation lifecycle doc for both patterns (alias + shim) with rollback steps? include edge cases: multi-account ACM, wildcard use, and customer-managed certs.
Jon: yup, I'll put up a doc in docs/arch by tomorrow and link back.
Mike: FYI: watch quotas — ENI growth + endpoint limits will need a capacity ticket if we lean PrivateLink.
Alex: thanks all — we'll reconvene after the spike. :thumbsup:
